Video-on-demand (ShemarooMe) | revenue = | operating_income = | website = {{URL|https://shemarooent.com/}} }} '''Shemaroo Entertainment Ltd.''' is an Indian content creator, aggregator and distributor, specifically in the media and entertainment industry. It was founded by Buddhichand Maroo in 1962 as a book-circulating library under the name Shemaroo. It set up India's first [[Video rental shop|video rental]] business in 1979.{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/entertainment/hindi/bollywood/news/film-production-distribution-house-gets-a-revamp-after-five-decades/articleshow/64955624.cms|title=Film production & distribution house gets a revamp after six decades|website=The Times of India|date=12 July 2018 |access-date=24 April 2019}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.forbes.com/sites/bedatrichoudhury/2019/04/17/shemaroo-streams-bollywood-into-the-us/|title=Shemaroo Streams Bollywood into The US|last=Choudhury|first=Bedatri|website=Forbes|access-date=24 April 2019}} The company went national after it began [[Digital distribution|content distribution]] in 1987, became aggregators and bought rights to movies for [[home video]].{{Cite web|url=http://www.indiantelevision.com/television/tv-channels/music-and-youth/shemaroo-entertainment-s-founder-buddhichand-maroo-felicitated-with-gifa-golden-award-181219|title=Shemaroo Entertainment's Founder Buddhichand Maroo Felicitated with GIFA Golden Award|date=19 December 2018|website=Indian Television Dot Com|access-date=24 April 2019}} Currently, the brand has a collection of over 3700 movie titles in multiple Indian languages and offers services to customers in over 30 countries including the [[United States|US]], the [[United Kingdom|UK]], [[Singapore]], [[United Arab Emirates|UAE]] and [[Australia]].{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-sector-media-entertainment/shemaroo-entertainment-the-content-connoisseurs-117012000290_1.html|title=Shemaroo Entertainment: The Content Connoisseurs|last=indiainfoline.com|access-date=24 April 2019}} ==History== === Early years === Shemaroo Entertainment is an acronym for the founders’ surnames. The library was located at Warden Road in [[South Mumbai]]. Three branches were opened soon after.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/how-family-run-enterprise-shemaroo-grew-from-local-to-a-national-brand/articleshow/9669109.cms|title=How family-run enterprise Shemaroo grew from local to a national brand|last=Raghavendra|first=Nandini|date=24 August 2011|work=The Economic Times|access-date=24 April 2019}} In 1987, the company forayed into content distribution via the VHS format, which was labeled Shemaroo Video Private Ltd. They also bought rights to several movies for home video and were one of the first brands involved in the distribution of video rights in India.{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/shemaroo-entertainment-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-57482.cms|title=Shemaroo Entertainment History {{!}} Shemaroo Entertainment Information |website=The Economic Times|access-date=24 April 2019}} Shemaroo started buying cable and pay television rights in the 1990s. In 1995, the company bought an equity stake in [[Sony Entertainment Television|Sony's Indian TV channel]] while negotiating a deal to buy films of Sony's Columbia Tristar. === 2000s to present === Shemaroo ventured into film production with movies like ''[[Kuchh Meetha Ho Jaye|Kuch Meetha Ho Jaye]]'', ''[[Omkara (2006 film)|Omkara]], [[Ishqiya]], [[Dedh Ishqiya]]'' and ''[[Hunterrr]]''. These were followed by several others in the subsequent years. The company forayed into digital animated films with ''[[Bal Ganesh]]'' and ''[[Ghatothkach]]'' as their initial features and became the only company to release a feature every year thereafter.{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/media/entertainment/big-budget-animation-from-bollywood-in-08/articleshow/2560324.cms |title=Big budget animation from Bollywood in '08|last=Sapre|first=Omkar|date=22 November 2007|work=The Economic Times|access-date=24 April 2019}} In 2012, Shemaroo completed 50 years of operations. In 2018, the company unveiled a new logo and tagline ‘''India Khush Hua’''. In January 2020, Shemaroo Group launched its first TV channel named Shemaroo Marathibana. It is a 24-hour FTA Marathi movie channel with the tagline 'Assal Filmi' (translated as 'Made for Entertainment'). Swapnil Joshi is its Brand Ambassador. It airs Marathi movies like ''Aapla Manus'', ''Thackeray'', ''Bhai Vyakti Ki Valli'', ''Judgement'', ''Cycle'', ''Ani Dr. Kashinath Ghanekar'', etc.{{Cite news|url=https://www.afaqs.com/news/media/shemaroo-launches-marathi-movie-channel-marathibana-2 |title=Shemaroo launches Marathi movie channel, 'MarathiBana'|date=15 Jan 2020|work=aFAQS!|access-date=24 April 2019}} In 2020, Shemaroo Group also announced the launch of a new Hindi GEC Shemaroo TV.{{Cite news|url=https://brandequity.economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/media/shemaroo-launches-hindi-entertainment-channel-shemaroo-tv/75450209 |title=Shemaroo launches Hindi entertainment channel -Shemaroo TV|date=April 30, 2020|work=ETBrandEquity |access-date=24 April 2019}} In May 2020, a video surfaced where the comedian Surleen Kaur made a remark about [[Krishna]], a [[Hindu deities|Hindu deity]], which right-leaning media houses and political parties objected to. Following the controversy, Shemaroo announced their decision to refrain from any further involvement with Surleen Kaur and Balraj Syal because they 'failed to meet their standards of public decency'. Subsequently, [[International Society for Krishna Consciousness|ISKCON]] lodged a complaint against Kaur and Shemaroo with the [[Mumbai Police]] for insulting the organisation and [[Hindus]].{{Cite web |title=Comedian Surleen Kaur in soup over derogatory quips against ISKON, Hinduism |url=https://www.tribuneindia.com/news/nation/comedian-surleen-kaur-in-soup-over-derogatory-quips-against-iskon-hinduism-91613 |access-date=2022-06-30 |website=TribuneIndia |language=en}} In 2019, the company ventured into the pre-loaded audio speaker market and introduced Bluetooth speakers loaded with devotional content. The pricing for all three existing products in store (online & offline) – Bhagavad Gita, Bhajan Vaani and Quran Majeed And is available in the market currently with leading offline and online retailers.{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiatvnews.com/technology/news-shemaroo-entertainment-launches-pre-loaded-audio-speakers-in-the-indian-market-541195 |title=Shemaroo Entertainment launches pre-loaded audio speakers in the Indian market|date=August 8, 2019|work=India TV News|access-date=24 April 2019}} In 2019, Shemaroo launched 'Shemaroo Bhakti Shri Ganesha Bhajan Vaani' during Ganesh Chaturthi, and 'Shemaroo Amritbani' on the 550th birth anniversary of Shri Guru Nanak Dev Ji.{{Cite They also have an online presence on YouTube, where their channels receive an estimated 2.2 billion monthly views on average.{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/u7DPwtxvwoVpeHhLJ9OrDO/Shemaroo-scripts-digital-makeover-with-streaming-tieups.html|title=Shemaroo scripts digital makeover with streaming tie-ups|last=Jha|first=Lata|date=26 December 2018|website=Mint|access-date=24 April 2019}} Their partners include major DTH platforms such as [[Airtel digital TV]], [[Tata Sky]] and [[Dish TV]], and TV Networks such as [[Sony Pictures Networks|Sony Network]], [[Star India|Star TV]] and [[Viacom18|Colors Network]]. February 2019, Shemaroo Entertainment launched its own [[Video on demand|video-on-demand]] service app called ''ShemarooMe,'' which is available for [[Android (operating system)|Android]] and [[iOS]].{{Cite web|url=https://gadgets.ndtv.com/entertainment/news/shemaroo-launches-video-streaming-app-shemaroome-for-android-ios-and-web-1993166|title=Shemaroo Launches Video Streaming App ShemarooMe for Android, iOS, and Web|website=NDTV Gadgets 360|date=13 February 2019 |access-date=24 April 2019}} It is also available on the web for viewers. The Bollywood actor [[Tiger Shroff]] was present at the launch event of this app in Mumbai.{{Cite web|url=https://www.msn.com/hi-in/news/india/tiger-shroff-launches-shemaroo-me-app-filmibeat/vp-BBTyA6N|title=Tiger Shroff Launches Shemaroo Me App {{!}} Filmibeat|publisher=MSN|access-date=24 April 2019}} The OTT [[Streaming media|video streaming]] service primarily provides content from the company's content library including movies, TV shows, songs, etc.{{Cite web|url=https://www.exchange4media.com/digital-news/shemaroo-launches-ott-platform-shemaroome-94672.html|title=Shemaroo launches OTT platform, ShemarooMe |website=Exchange4media|access-date=24 April 2019}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.televisionpost.com/shemaroo-launches-ott-app-with-two-subscription-plans-looks-to-enter-us-market-in-coming-quarter/|title=Shemaroo launches OTT app with two subscription plans, looks to enter US market in coming quarter|date=14 February 2019|website=TelevisionPost|access-date=24 April 2019|archive-date=15 February 2019|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190215151045/https://www.televisionpost.com/shemaroo-launches-ott-app-with-two-subscription-plans-looks-to-enter-us-market-in-coming-quarter/|url-status=dead}} The content is available in languages like Hindi, Gujarati, Marathi, South Indian Languages, Dub Versions of many languages and Punjabi. The service follows a [[freemium]] business model. Some of the content is available for users to stream for free, and the rest requires a subscription to be accessed. It was launched in the US in April 2019.{{Cite press release|url=https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/leading-indian-entertainment-company-shemaroo-enters-the-us-market-with-the-launch-of-its-direct-to-consumer-ott-platform-shemaroome-300833625.html|title=Leading Indian Entertainment Company Shemaroo Enters the US Market with the Launch of its Direct-To-Consumer OTT Platform "ShemarooMe"|last=Limited|first=Shemaroo Entertainment|agency=PR Newswire|access-date=24 April 2019}} In July 2020, ShemarooMe announced the launch of its new on-demand movie platform called 'ShemarooMe Box Office.' Shemaroo Entertainment Ltd. is an Indian content creator, aggregator and distributor, specifically in the media and entertainment industry. It was founded by Buddhichand Maroo in 1962 as a book-circulating library under the name Shemaroo. It set up India's first video rental business in 1979. The company went national after it began content distribution in 1987, became aggregators and bought rights to movies for home video.
Currently, the brand has a collection of over 3700 movie titles in multiple Indian languages and offers services to customers in over 30 countries including the US, the UK, Singapore, UAE and Australia.
